title: Fetching for the Tables

readiness.math: counting out sets to match a list (older: larger numbers)

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: We're ready to build! Here's my list of what we need from the shelf.

intro.speaker: amos
intro.text: Read it carefully: the right number of each.

steps.speaker: amos
steps.prompt: Read the list. Put the right things in the basket, then press Done.

older.prompt: Read the list: no pictures. Fetch the right number of each, then press Done.

outro.speaker: amos
outro.text: With your careful counting, we didn't waste a single nail.

journal_line: I read Mr. Amos's list and fetched what we needed for the tables.
